interface.authentication: existing authenticated backend user; engine inventory uses existing sealed service token, principal, engine:read scope and tenant grant
interface.source: only current canonical engine ProviderRegistry inventory; application code never constructs a provider or reads provider credentials
interface.selection: optional exact provider_id/model_id pair from current runtime inventory; both omitted selects current active ready model; unknown, unavailable or unsupported selection fails before conversation/model dispatch
interface.failure: typed stable readiness code/message/action; no raw exception, credential, service URL, transport URL, filesystem path, prompt or weight data
interface.availability: available means at least one exact model pair is selectable; automatic_available preserves current active+declared-fallback routing readiness

runtime_limits.source: conservative engine chat policy limits, not advertised vendor context capacities
runtime_limits.admission: selection context/output ceilings compile into existing ContextBudget and ResourceBudget; canonical provider admission and actual usage remain authoritative
runtime_limits.temperature: optional sampling temperature only for known OpenAI gpt-4o/gpt-4.1 model families; local, unknown or reasoning-model families remain unsupported; automatic routing requires every eligible route to support it

local_readiness.startup_diagnostics: optional engine-only retain_unavailable registry construction preserves a non-dispatchable canonical local descriptor when activation is missing or invalid; default from_env construction remains fail-closed
local_readiness.no_model_fabrication: an unloaded local artifact has no model_id and contributes provider readiness only, never a selectable synthetic model
local_readiness.activation_identity: existing validated content-only artifact schema/model/digest/byte receipt; no artifact path or weight exposure
local_readiness.handoff: operator configures existing AI_PROVIDER=local and AI_LOCAL_MODEL_PATH from governed training output and restarts engine; public chat catalog does not accept paths, change provider configuration, hot-load weights or grant production promotion
local_readiness.neural_conditioning: bounded full rendered instructions, conversation history, user prompt and assistant role framing prime the native recurrent model; canonical admission counts exact UTF-8 bytes plus BOS

validation: source review and formatting only in this wave; user explicitly requested no test creation or execution
scope_limitations: read-only runtime configuration readiness; no external provider health probe or generation during discovery
actual models registered by engine only
conservative chat ceilings may be smaller than vendor model capacities
no credential values, new provider transport, new runtime owner or remote activation authority
no masterplan closure, production promotion or verified-quality claim
